best_idea: Keep all static floor tiles in one batch that is drawn once per frame, offer a per-device quality flag that picks between a direct draw and an offscreen pass, and redraw the offscreen pass only when the floor changes.
decision_why: Keep the one-batch floor draw, the per-device quality flag and the corner-code edge choice for zone floor edges; the tilt composite does not fit a 3D third-person camera, and the per-frame re-raster needs a dirty flag before it ships.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, the frame-stats log shows at most two draw calls for the static floor per frame, zero floor re-raster on frames with no change, and no visible seams between floor tiles at the default quality.
